info.name: Sfxon Train
info.summary: Free employee training for workplace safety, with tracking and recurring refreshers.
info.description:
Training helps organizations plan, run and document employee training directly in Nextcloud. It is designed for small and medium-sized businesses that need a simple way to keep track of mandatory instruction without additional software or licensing costs.
**Typical training topics**
* Occupational health and safety * Workplace safety * Behavior in case of fire * First aid * Correct posture and ergonomics at the workplace * Other company-specific topics
**Features**
* Provide training for your employees on a variety of topics * Keep a record of who was trained, when, and how * Schedule recurring trainings so that refresher courses are not forgotten * Maintain a clear overview of the training status across your organization
**Why use it?**
Many companies are required to train their employees regularly and to be able to prove it. Training keeps these records in one place, inside your own Nextcloud instance, so your data stays under your control.
The app is free to use.
info.author: Steve Krämer
